title: Play with the Voice of Destiny!

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Getting to spend time together like this really makes me happy."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (—Heheh! Who knew you could make a face like that, Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what else there is? I wanna see!
All kinds of expressions I've never seen before...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Student A
text_block_list.text:
Somehow we ended up playing all day long, huh~.
Thanks for inviting me today!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Student B
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I got to see so many new sides of you, Senpai...
Um, if it's okay with you, wanna go again sometime!?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Student A
text_block_list.text: —! Yeah, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(I get it! If we go all out having fun, then I can too...!
—Aha! Even the voice of destiny is telling me so!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off—after an early morning ambush, I was dragged to an amusement park with Epiphaneia.
As usual, it seemed the "voice of destiny" was involved.
choice_data_list: (I'm still sleepy... but I might as well make the most of it.)
(I'm still sleepy... but I might as well make the most of it.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's ride that first! Go-karts!
Together, we're aiming for top speed!!
choice_data_list: Alright! You got it!
Okay! You got it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOH!!
With the two of us, we can go way faster!!
choice_data_list: GOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Look! It says 2 minutes 23.1 seconds!
We totally blew past everyone else!!
choice_data_list: No way, you're right... We did it, Epi!
No way, you're right... We did it, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Hahaha, that right there! That hyped-up smile!
I love it, Trainer! Yeah... it's awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So we use these guns to take down monsters, huh? Alright, let's aim for the high score!
Trainer, stick close to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (GWWAAAAARRGH!!)
choice_data_list: Whoaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you!! —You okay, Trainer?
Still, if it starts off like this right from the get-go, it's gonna be a hell of a thrill!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, look at that face. Were you really that scared of zombies?
choice_data_list: W-Well, even adults get startled when jumped at.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, fair enough!
Hmm... It's not a smile, but that face is fresh and hilarious too!
choice_data_list: Hilarious, huh... Well, as long as you're having fun, Epi.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're taking commemorative photos over there!
Wanna take one together!?
choice_data_list: Sounds great! Let's—
Sounds fun! Let's—

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, sir! Would you like horse ear headbands?
You can match with your companion!
choice_data_list: ...Maybe wearing something like this once in a while is fine?

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, ma'am! Would you like horse ear headbands?
You can match with your companion!
choice_data_list: ...Maybe wearing something like this once in a while is fine?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, suits you! You look just like an Umamusume, Trainer!
Alright staff member, snap one for us too!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the photo handed over by the staff.
Both Epiphaneia and I, wearing horse ears, were captured beaming ear-to-ear.
choice_data_list: I look... pretty carried away with myself.
I look... pretty carried away with myself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with that?
I think you look fantastic when you're caught up in the fun!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, coming to the amusement park was definitely the right call!
I've seen nothing but new expressions all day!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...And I wanna see way, way more!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, we haven't checked out this area yet, right? An arcade area, huh—
Oh! Wouldn't that be perfect!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia points toward—the "Heart-Throbbing Compatibility Test."
The sign reads, "You might discover a whole new side of each other!?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It says "new side"! Hey, I wanna do this!!
Come on, what do you say, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's go now! Right now! Hurry, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Machine Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Face each other and stare deep into their eyes♡
Place one hand on the sensor—and start your Heart-Throbbing Compatibility Test!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the cramped booth, I stand face-to-face with Epiphaneia.
The atmosphere radiating from the machine is... frankly, pretty embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Machine Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Answer the randomly selected questions honestly♡
Starting with the player on the left, here is your first question—What was your first impression of your partner?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—First impression?
My destiny!! I just knew it intuitively, that you were the only one!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No one else could ever compare!
Ever since that day I found you—you're my one and only destiny!
choice_data_list: ...I see. Thank you.
...I see. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Next is your turn, Trainer! What was your first impression of me!
choice_data_list: How should I put it, um, sparks—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I knew it!
It really is you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that the moment our eyes met, it felt as though sparks flew—
that's just how intense our first encounter was.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
! You saw it too, Trainer? The spark of destiny!
—Haha, talk about mutual love!
choice_data_list: Well, I suppose you could put it that way.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all,
you don't have eyes for anyone but me either, right?

text_block_list.name: Machine Announcement
text_block_list.text: "Now for the next question! What is your favorite thing about your partner?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Next one already?—Let's see, your expressions!
Being with you today reminded me again, they change constantly and I never get tired of watching!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
When you're surprised or flustered, it's super cute,
and seeing you have fun makes me wanna make you even happier!
choice_data_list: (...As straightforward as ever.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haha! I love that bashful look you have right now too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, what do you like about me, Trainer?
Won't you tell me?
choice_data_list: Hmm... Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The answer that came to mind was—her "eyes." Ever since we met,
I had always found that comet-like brilliance captivating.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My eyes, huh? Makes sense—I know!
If you like 'em that much, you can look even closer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next second, she yanks my hand,
pulling her face right up to mine in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Here, look all you want! Oh, should I get closer!?
Alright, even closer—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BONK!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The world spins, and stars flash before my eyes.
In her excessive enthusiasm, Epiphaneia apparently delivered a massive headbutt.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! My bad, I went too far!
Next is... "What is an embarrassing secret you haven't told your partner?" it says!
choice_data_list: What kind of question is that!?
What kind of question is that!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like an interesting question to me! I don't have one, but—what about you, Trainer?
From that reaction, you definitely do! Come on, tell me, tell me!
choice_data_list: P-Please, have mercy—!!
P-Please, have mercy—!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The result is—75%? Well, not bad for a first try!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This game is awesome! I learned so much about you.
And I got to see tons of new expressions too! It was the best!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like nobody's in line.
Perfect timing, let's play again!
choice_data_list: Play again!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There must be questions that didn't pop up earlier, right? That means
I might see even more faces I haven't seen before! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Epiphaneia took quite a liking to the "Compatibility Test,"
and having accompanied her through several rounds—before we knew it, night had completely fallen.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a blast!
Didn't we conquer pretty much every question by now?
choice_data_list: It's pitch-black out. Should we head home soon?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm not letting you go home yet!
There's still time before closing, and we haven't seen the parade!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's play our hearts out until the very last second!
I'm sure I'll get to see even more new faces—the voice of destiny says so too!
